sourceNote: 古代の咆哮: Scarlet & Violet era set, 30 packs x 5 cards. ANCHORED, not set-measured: pokemon-infomation.com has published independent box tallies for EIGHT sibling SV-era sets (黒炎の支配者, レイジングサーフ, クリムゾンヘイズ, ナイトワンダラー, 熱風のアリーナ and the High Class sets), 600-2,000 boxes each, and the regular/enhanced sets agree tier by tier: SAR ~20%/box, 3 AR guaranteed, SR ~75-80%/box, UR ~10%/box, with one SR-or-better per box. This set applies those sibling figures (SR at the 77.5% midpoint). Confidence stays LOW deliberately: these are measurements of OTHER sets in the same product line, not of this one. RR at ~4.5/box comes from the same tallies' box breakdowns. Guarantees are folded into the rates, not modelled as floors.
